data.content_ref: inline:The mechanism misapplies the claim's criterion to the evidence. If the test's validity depends on the same author as the subject's validity (the criterion offered), then all modules in the record fail the independence condition, not just compile.py. The target cannot account for the 4/4 to 6/7 distribution without arbitrarily treating physical file separation as epistemic separation, contradicting its own 'single authority' standard.
